source: measured on three EU V 1.0.3/1.0.4 OOS pairs, 2026-10-01. Tuned 2026-10-01 on the pairs 11c0de175691b2bb / 2e5541e097da87ce / 9591f7274fdf952e (numbers are cause units per pair before the change): nodeDepth 4 -> 5 because disease_outbreak_manager/data/[i]/locations (up to 1.6 MB) and data/[i]/sub_units (up to 379 KB) stayed TooLarge (2 / 0 / 6), costs about 160k more block nodes per side (index 83 -> 108 MB per side); with both sides indexed one after the other the peak working set of a whole run is 364-378 MB; anonymousIds disease_outbreak_manager/**/locations = location so one added location does not shift all later entries (93k list entries named by their location id). Consequence patterns (cause units 254 / 3458 / 2144 before, 45 / 87 / 391 after; the known causes countries/database/1384 government/parliament/parliament_issue_support (11c0), construction_manager none vs block and subunit_manager slot reuse (9591) stay causes): population/database/*/price (0 / 2064 / 78) pop prices follow the market every tick; population/database/*/all_levies/** (0 / 0 / 565) levy figures are recounted from the subunits; trade_manager/database/** (57 / 180 / 20) and trade_path_manager/database/** (19 / 94 / 4) trades and their paths, including slot reuse, are rebuilt from market prices; estate_manager/database/*/trade|gold|last|last_expense|last_month_income_*|tax (0 / 313 / 0 for trade, then 71, 27, 13, 44, 17 in 2e55) monthly estate income sums; locations/locations/*/counters/**|possible_tax|tax|estate_tax/**|value_flow|local_proximity_propagation|market_attraction (0 / 189 / 1 for counters, up to 69 / 15 for the others) location economy aggregates; building_manager/database/*/last_months_profit|upkeep|*_maintenance (1 / 163 / 4, 0 / 69 / 0, 8 / 7 / 60) building balance sheets; countries/database/*/economy/**|score/**|monthly_trade_*|estimated_monthly_income*|balance_history_2/** (9 / 144 / 12 for economy, 85 / 57 / 0 for score) country sums, rankings and history; rebel_manager/database/*/last_investment (1 / 22 / 1) and market_manager/database/*/food_supply|trade (0 / 9 / 0) monthly sums; disease_outbreak_manager/**/resistance (2 / 0 / 60) random rolls per entry; disease_outbreak_manager/**/sub_units/** (0 / 0 / 509) per-subunit disease state follows the subunit_manager; military_objective/** (27 / 7 / 518), strategic_military_objective/** (0 / 0 / 8) and diplomatic_objective/** (3 / 0 / 18) are AI planning state like ai_memory. The whole-unit patterns (trade_manager/database/**, trade_path_manager/database/**, the three objective managers and disease_outbreak_manager/**/sub_units/**) also demote one-sided and slot-reused objects, e.g. 67 military_objective SlotReused and 447 one-sided disease sub_unit entries in 9591; field-level forms (military_objective/database/*/*/**, .../sub_units/*/*/**) left 965 cause units in 9591

explain.de: Der Zufallsgenerator wurde auf den Rechnern unterschiedlich oft aufgerufen. Gleiche random_count-Werte im Spielstand heißen nicht, dass der Zufall gleich lief: der Spielstand wird später geschrieben als die Prüfsumme.
explain.en: The random generator was called a different number of times on the machines. Equal random_count values in the save do not mean the randomness ran the same: the save is written later than the checksum.

causes.de: Zufall in Skript, das nur auf einem Rechner ausgewertet wird (GUI, is_shown, lokale Effekte)
causes.en: Randomness in script that is evaluated on one machine only (GUI, is_shown, local effects)

fields.label: I have verified my game files (on Steam)

advice.text: All players must run the same game build: {detail}.
Make sure all players have the same DLCs enabled. Differing: {detail}.
Make sure all players use the same mods and mod versions. Differing: {detail}.

The random generator was called a different number of times on the machines. Look for random effects or triggers (random, random_list, weights) in script that runs on one machine only: GUI, is_shown/is_valid of interface elements, player-specific checks.

explain.de: has_local_dlc prüft die DLCs des eigenen Rechners. In synchronem Skript (Effekte, Events, on_actions, Effekte von Scripted GUIs) nehmen Rechner mit unterschiedlichen DLCs verschiedene Zweige und laufen auseinander (Out of Sync). Verwende has_dlc (die DLCs des Hosts) für das Spielgeschehen; has_local_dlc ist nur für Grafik und Oberfläche gedacht.
explain.en: has_local_dlc checks the DLCs of the local machine. In synced script (effects, events, on_actions, scripted GUI effects) machines with different DLCs take different branches and go out of sync. Use has_dlc (the host's DLCs) for gameplay; keep has_local_dlc for graphics and interface.
explain.es: has_local_dlc comprueba los DLC del equipo local. En script sincronizado (efectos, eventos, on_actions, efectos de GUI con script) los equipos con DLC distintos toman ramas distintas y se desincronizan. Usa has_dlc (los DLC del anfitrión) para la jugabilidad; reserva has_local_dlc para gráficos e interfaz.
explain.fr: has_local_dlc vérifie les DLC de la machine locale. Dans un script synchronisé (effets, événements, on_actions, effets des GUI scriptées), des machines avec des DLC différents prennent des branches différentes et se désynchronisent. Utilisez has_dlc (les DLC de l'hôte) pour le gameplay ; réservez has_local_dlc aux graphismes et à l'interface.
explain.pl: has_local_dlc sprawdza dodatki DLC lokalnego komputera. W skrypcie synchronizowanym (efekty, zdarzenia, on_actions, efekty skryptowanych GUI) komputery z różnymi DLC wybierają różne gałęzie i tracą synchronizację. Używaj has_dlc (DLC hosta) do rozgrywki; has_local_dlc zostaw dla grafiki i interfejsu.
explain.pt-br: has_local_dlc verifica as DLCs da máquina local. Em script sincronizado (efeitos, eventos, on_actions, efeitos de GUIs com script) máquinas com DLCs diferentes seguem ramos diferentes e saem de sincronia. Use has_dlc (as DLCs do anfitrião) para a jogabilidade; mantenha has_local_dlc para gráficos e interface.
explain.ru: has_local_dlc проверяет DLC локального компьютера. В синхронизируемом скрипте (эффекты, события, on_actions, эффекты скриптовых GUI) компьютеры с разными DLC идут по разным ветвям и рассинхронизируются. Для игрового процесса используйте has_dlc (DLC хоста); has_local_dlc оставьте для графики и интерфейса.
explain.zh-hans: has_local_dlc 检查本机的 DLC。在同步脚本(效果、事件、on_actions、脚本化 GUI 的效果)中,DLC 不同的机器会进入不同的分支并导致不同步。游戏玩法请使用 has_dlc(主机的 DLC);has_local_dlc 仅用于图形和界面。

explain.de: Konsolenbefehl für Oberfläche, Grafik oder Fehlersuche. Er ändert den Spielzustand nicht.
explain.en: Interface, graphics or debug console command. It does not change the game state.
explain.es: Comando de consola de interfaz, gráficos o depuración. No cambia el estado del juego.
explain.fr: Commande de console pour l'interface, les graphismes ou le débogage. Elle ne modifie pas l'état du jeu.
explain.pl: Polecenie konsoli dotyczące interfejsu, grafiki lub debugowania. Nie zmienia stanu gry.
explain.pt-br: Comando de console de interface, gráficos ou depuração. Ele não altera o estado do jogo.
explain.ru: Команда консоли для интерфейса, графики или отладки. Она не меняет состояние игры.
explain.zh-hans: 用于界面、图形或调试的控制台命令。它不会改变游戏状态。

explain.de: Der Konsolenbefehl wird erst zur Laufzeit zusammengesetzt, PMT kann daher nicht erkennen, was er tut. Prüfe, ob er den Spielzustand ändern kann.
explain.en: The console command is built at run time, so PMT cannot tell what it does. Check whether it can change the game state.
explain.es: El comando de consola se construye en tiempo de ejecución, por lo que PMT no puede saber qué hace. Comprueba si puede cambiar el estado del juego.
explain.fr: La commande de console est construite à l'exécution, PMT ne peut donc pas savoir ce qu'elle fait. Vérifiez si elle peut modifier l'état du jeu.
explain.pl: Polecenie konsoli jest składane dopiero w trakcie działania, więc PMT nie może stwierdzić, co robi. Sprawdź, czy może zmienić stan gry.
explain.pt-br: O comando de console é montado em tempo de execução, então o PMT não consegue saber o que ele faz. Verifique se ele pode alterar o estado do jogo.
explain.ru: Команда консоли формируется во время работы, поэтому PMT не может определить, что она делает. Проверьте, может ли она изменить состояние игры.
explain.zh-hans: 该控制台命令是在运行时拼接而成的,PMT 无法判断它的作用。请检查它是否可能改变游戏状态。

explain.de: Konsolenbefehl, von dem nicht bekannt ist, dass er nur die Oberfläche betrifft. Prüfe, ob er im Mehrspielerbetrieb (MP) den Spielzustand ändert, und markiere ihn als unbedenklich oder riskant.
explain.en: Console command that is not known to be interface only. Check whether it changes the game state in multiplayer, and mark it as harmless or risky.
explain.es: Comando de consola que no se sabe que afecte solo a la interfaz. Comprueba si cambia el estado del juego en multijugador (MP) y márcalo como inofensivo o arriesgado.
explain.fr: Commande de console dont on ne sait pas qu'elle ne concerne que l'interface. Vérifiez si elle modifie l'état du jeu en multijoueur (MP) et marquez-la comme inoffensive ou risquée.
explain.pl: Polecenie konsoli, o którym nie wiadomo, czy dotyczy tylko interfejsu. Sprawdź, czy zmienia stan gry w trybie wieloosobowym (MP), i oznacz je jako nieszkodliwe lub ryzykowne.
explain.pt-br: Comando de console que não se sabe ser apenas de interface. Verifique se ele altera o estado do jogo no multijogador (MP) e marque-o como inofensivo ou arriscado.
explain.ru: Команда консоли, про которую неизвестно, что она относится только к интерфейсу. Проверьте, меняет ли она состояние игры в мультиплеере (MP), и отметьте её как безвредную или рискованную.
explain.zh-hans: 未知是否仅影响界面的控制台命令。请检查它在多人游戏(MP)中是否会改变游戏状态,并将其标记为无害或有风险。
